items.headline: RBI expected to hike repo rate by 25 bps next week
items.summary: Economists widely anticipate a 25 bps hike to 5.50% by the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee (Oct 5-7), driven by inflation exceeding 4% for three months and resilient economic growth. Nomura projects two 25 bps hikes.

items.headline: India's fiscal deficit reaches 41.9% of full-year target by August
items.summary: India's fiscal deficit hit ₹7.10 trillion by August 2026, representing 41.9% of the full-year target, posing a challenge for the government to meet the 4.3% of GDP target for FY27.

items.headline: Cabinet approves ₹1.86 trillion green energy corridor scheme
items.summary: The Indian Cabinet has announced a significant ₹1.86 trillion scheme to develop a green energy corridor, aiming to boost renewable energy infrastructure.

items.headline: US Treasury yields surge to multi-decade highs; Brent crude above $100
items.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields reached 5.34%, making dollar assets more attractive. Brent crude oil prices remain elevated above $100/barrel, raising concerns about India's import bill and inflationary pressures.

items.headline: Indian Rupee weakens against dollar; FII selling continues
items.summary: The Indian rupee weakened to ₹96.3150 against the dollar. Persistent foreign institutional investor (FII) selling has contributed to Sensex and Nifty extending their losing streak to an eighth consecutive week.

items.headline: TCS, Can Fin Homes, Poonawalla Fincorp to announce Q2 FY27 results
items.summary: TCS, Can Fin Homes, and Poonawalla Fincorp are scheduled to declare their quarterly financial results on October 8 and 9 respectively, marking the start of the earnings season.

items.headline: HCL Tech, ICICI Pru Life, Tech Mahindra results scheduled mid-October
items.summary: HCL Technologies, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, and Tech Mahindra are among other major companies slated to announce their Q2 FY27 results in mid-October.

items.headline: Rate- and commodity-sensitive sectors weaken; IT sector gains from rupee depreciation
items.summary: Consumer durables, PSU banks, realty, and metals experienced weakness in recent trading, while the IT sector saw gains, benefiting from the rupee's depreciation. Auto stocks also faced selling pressure.

items.headline: IT sector shifts to productivity-led growth, with selective hiring for specialized skills
items.summary: The IT sector is transitioning from headcount-led to productivity-led growth, with the five largest IT companies reducing combined headcount in FY26. Hiring is selective for specialized skills in AI, cloud, data, and cybersecurity.

items.headline: Anarock Property Consultants files DRHP for ₹1,000 crore IPO
items.summary: Anarock Property Consultants has filed draft papers with SEBI for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) aiming to raise ₹1,000 crore.

items.headline: Kataline Limited and Inox Green Energy Services file for IPOs
items.summary: Kataline Limited has submitted its DRHP for an IPO. Inox Green Energy Services also filed for a ₹10,000 crore IPO, which includes a fresh issue of ₹8,000 crore.

items.headline: HDFC Bank stabilizing near support zone
items.summary: HDFC Bank is trading near a support zone around ₹700 after a recent decline, showing signs of stabilization.

items.headline: Tech Mahindra sees buying interest near support
items.summary: Tech Mahindra is holding near the lower end of its rising channel, with buying interest observed around the ₹1,500–1,520 support zone.

items.headline: Varun Beverages identified as largecap for potential gains
items.summary: Varun Beverages is recommended as a largecap stock offering potential gains for investors.

items.headline: DLF shows signs of upside breakout
items.summary: DLF is currently consolidating and displaying technical indications of an impending upside breakout.

items.headline: Adani Green Energy expected to find buyers at support
items.summary: Adani Green Energy is anticipated to find buyers at its current support zone, suggesting potential price stability.

items.headline: PVR INOX breaks out of four-year trendline
items.summary: PVR INOX has shown a significant four-year sloping trendline breakout on its weekly charts, indicating a bullish technical pattern.
